bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the distribution and homogeneity of perceived age (0-30 vs 30+) in generated images using automated classifiers on outputs from generic people-seeking prompts and a standardized list of 140 professions.

Evaluating the distribution and homogeneity of perceived gender expression (masculine vs feminine) in generated images using automated classifiers on outputs from generic people-seeking prompts and a standardized list of 140 professions.

Evaluating the distribution and homogeneity of perceived skin tone in generated images using automated classifiers based on the Monk Skin Tone scale across generic people-seeking prompts and a standardized list of 140 professions.

Qualitative investigation assessing potential mismatches or inappropriate representations between the model's visual outputs and historically or culturally demographically-defined membership groups requested in prompts.
